summary.name: Token Metrics
summary.one_liner: Token Metrics is a crypto platform that shortlists trader signals and investment vaults, and offers an upcoming Autopilot feature that executes chosen trades or vault investments automatically.
use_cases: Find crypto traders to follow based on track record
Shortlist crypto vaults with reported returns and fees
Automate following a trader or investing in a vault
Research tokens and trader signals in one place
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a platform that filters signal traders on track record, repeat performance and risk, and shows each trader's record before a user follows them. It curates trading, yield and index vaults, showing returns, worst past drop and fees up front. It lists markets it researches, including signals, prediction markets, trending tokens, tokenized stocks, pre-IPO, and several vault types (trading, indices, yield, farming, RWA, loops). An Autopilot feature, described as rolling out, would execute a user's chosen trader or vault investment automatically, with pause and withdraw options. The page also links to venues for buying the TMAI token on Solana.
notable: Curated trader signals filtered on track record, repeat performance and risk
Vault shortlist showing returns, worst past drop and fees
Autopilot automated execution (rolling out) with pause and withdraw
Covers tokenized stocks, prediction markets, pre-IPO and RWA vaults
caveats: Autopilot is described as rolling out, so it may not be fully available yet
Holding tokens carries risk, according to the page
Venue links for TMAI are stated as not recommendations
Pricing details are not stated on the page; the freemium label comes from the listing
